authority.note: Persistent human-reviewed responsibility ledger for current Desktop main. Historical Grok ledgers are not product-completion authority.

responsibilities.responsibility: Maintain source-neutral typed child destinations and actor-scoped lifecycle state for topics, SavedSublist histories, and nested/community conversations; validate pagination windows, monotonic read state, pin/active/unread/no-paid policy, exact-child destruction, membership authorization, and SyncBatch projection.
responsibilities.visible_effect: Child chat/topic/saved-sublist state survives sync and lifecycle operations without silently falling back to the parent conversation.
failure_behavior: SavedSublist non-self parent fails closed until source-neutral monoforum relation exists
responsibilities.cancellation_behavior: Source merge identifies request cancellation/retry for child history loading as still separate/open responsibility; do not invent successful cancellation semantics here.
responsibilities.retry_semantics: No blind replay of side-effecting lifecycle commands; preserve stable command identity when wired through Android Coordinator.
responsibilities.idempotency_semantics: Exact repeated state-setting may converge, but destroy/pagination/recovery still require durable command identity and reconciliation at Android wiring.
responsibilities.process_death_recovery: Must restore the same persisted child runtime state from the canonical Rust repository; UI recreation must not recreate or mutate canonical child truth.
responsibilities.account_fencing: Every projection/mutation must remain actor/account scoped and stale-account callbacks must be rejected by Coordinator epoch.
responsibilities.security_boundary: Membership/owner/community authorization is checked by Host/service before canonical child mutation.
responsibilities.android_owner: Rust canonical messaging owner behind Coordinator/Host; Android UI is projection-only
responsibilities.platform_delta: Core state machine is platform-independent Rust-to-Rust. Android lifecycle adds process-death recovery and typed JNI projection; no Kotlin duplicate owner.
responsibilities.production_wiring: open: current Android Host exposes placeholder feature.messaging.execute and does not yet prove a canonical conversation-child repository/protocol path.
responsibilities.unit_test: required: identity validation, backward cursor rejection, duplicate/bad pagination, pin restoration, exact destroy
responsibilities.contract_test: required: outsider denial, SavedSublist fail-closed parent rule, SyncBatch actor filtering
responsibilities.integration_test: required: Coordinator→Host mutation→durable store→JNI projection with account switch and process death
responsibilities.device_test: required: child destination lifecycle survives Activity recreation/process kill without duplicate mutation
responsibilities.notes: Mapped from the exact current Desktop main merge. No Android verified claim is made until production owner/wiring and same-HEAD evidence exist.
